entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The air was thick with the scent of honeysuckle.
entries.zh: 空气里充满了蜜糖的气味

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The warm air was scented with rosemary and orange blossom.
entries.zh: 温暖的空气充满迷迭香和橙色的花朵。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The lavender bush wafted its scent in through the open window.
entries.zh: 薰衣草的灌木丛从窗外的窗子里抽出香味

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They were surrounded by the perfume of the honeysuckle that clung to the oak tree.
entries.zh: 他们被橡树上的蜜糖的香水包围着

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was as if all the flowers and spices of the world had been blended together and tossed in the air.
entries.zh: 仿佛世界上所有的花朵和香料 都混合在一起 飘在空中

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Wafting in the air was the sweet smell of roasting vegetables and chicken.
entries.zh: 在空气中挥舞是烤蔬菜和鸡肉的甜味.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The fragrance of freshly mown grass and tree blossoms drifted towards her.
entries.zh: 新鲜的割草和树花的芳香飘向她身边.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The kitchen was filled with the warm, sweet aroma of coffee brewing.
entries.zh: 厨房里充满了咖啡酿造的温暖,甜美的香气.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The smell of pine needles and cinnamon filled the room with the scents of Christmas.
entries.zh: 松针和肉桂的气味使房间充满了圣诞节的气味.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She needed to leave the room to escape the smell of dust and mould.
entries.zh: 她需要离开房间 以逃避尘埃和模具的味道。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A stench of rottenness and decay wafted up from the darkness and stung his nostrils.
entries.zh: 一种腐烂腐烂的臭味从黑暗中卷起,并刺伤了他的鼻孔.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Even the plants seemed to give off a smell of rot and decaying corpses.
entries.zh: 甚至植物也散发出腐烂腐烂尸体的味道。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As he opened the trunk, a dank, musty smell was released into the cold air.
entries.zh: 当他打开后备箱时,一股阴沉的黏土气味被放入冷空气中.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her stomach churned, as the revolting smell of rotten fish drifted towards her.
entries.zh: 她的胃痛, 臭味的烂鱼飘向她。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The thick, rancid smell of warm petrol dogged the air and caught in the back of their throats.
entries.zh: 浓厚的、狂躁的暖气味缠绕着空气,在喉咙的后面夹住。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: They covered their nose and mouth to block out the putrefying smell of rotting meat.
entries.zh: 他们遮住鼻子和嘴 挡住腐肉的臭味

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A pungent smell of rotting rubbish came from the bulging bin bags, rancid in the heat and crawling with termites.
entries.zh: 一种腐烂的垃圾的浓郁气味来自堆积不平的垃圾袋,在炎热中狂躁,并爬上白蚁.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Clutching her hand to her mouth, she bent over and retched violently.
entries.zh: 把她的手伸进嘴里 她弯腰了 用力地抽筋

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She coughed and retched as the putrefying smell of decaying flesh wafted towards her.
entries.zh: 她咳嗽和重排 就像腐烂的肉向她挥舞的臭味

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The rock was as smooth as polished slate.
entries.zh: 岩石和抛光板一样光滑

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The hand that held his was as smooth as velvet.
entries.zh: 握着他的手和天鹅绒一样光滑

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A breath of wind, like rippling silk, tickled his ear.
entries.zh: 一口气风,如扯丝,痒其耳.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As the wind rose, she wrapped the warm, woollen coat tightly around her.
entries.zh: 随着风的升起,她将温暖的羊毛外套紧紧地包裹在身边.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The cold water of the pool was a welcome relief from the burning heat.
entries.zh: 水池的冷水是受人欢迎的解除燃烧的热量.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The coat was rough and scratched at his skin.
entries.zh: 那件外套很粗糙,划伤了他的皮肤。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her feet slipped on the squelching mud and she was sent tumbling into the murky water.
entries.zh: 她的脚滑到泥浆上,被送进浑浊的水中。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Something sleek and slimy slithered over his shoe and plucked at his ankle.
entries.zh: 他的鞋上滑了些粘稠的东西 扭伤了他的脚踝

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The jagged edges of the gate tore his hand as he pushed it open.
entries.zh: 门的边缘被他推开时撕裂了手

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He ducked, as a swish of wings rushed through the air and the invisible predator brushed his head with its furry body.
entries.zh: 他躲了起来,因为一股翅膀飞过空气,看不见的掠食者用它的毛毛身体刷他的头.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The prickly spines tangled in his clothes, clutching him in their thorny grasp.
entries.zh: 刺骨的脊椎缠在衣服上, 紧紧地抓住了他。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His hand touched something at the bottom of the bag; something slimy, like a dead fish.
entries.zh: 他的手触摸了袋子底部的东西; 黏糊糊的东西,像一条死鱼。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He crashed through the trees on the shore of the lake, but was held by the creeping, slimy water plants that crawled down the hillside and trapped his legs.
entries.zh: 他从湖岸的树上坠落,但被爬下山坡并困住腿部的爬行的粘稠水植物所牵制.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The chill air rubbed at her legs.
entries.zh: 寒冷的空气在她的腿上摩擦。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The hot, wet air enveloped her like a damp towel.
entries.zh: 湿热的空气像潮湿的毛巾一样包裹着她

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The hot fingers of dust clawed all over them.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was a savage, bone-crushing cold that scalded his skin like acid.
entries.zh: 这是一种野蛮的,骨折的寒冷 他的皮肤像酸。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She felt the heat of the sun on her exposed arms – a burning, stinging heat.
entries.zh: 她感到自己暴露手臂上的太阳热——一种燃烧,刺痛的热.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert could feel the icy breath on the back of his neck. Shivers ran down his spine, as if he had been touched by acid.
entries.zh: 罗伯特可以感觉到脖子背面的冰冷气息,希弗斯从脊椎下冲,好像被酸感动了一样.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As she inhaled, the dry air hurt her nose and burnt her nostrils.
entries.zh: 当她吸入时,干燥的空气伤害了她的鼻子,烧伤了她的鼻孔.
